description:
Hi, I'm Shuruthi, a 4th-year Aerospace Systems Engineering student joining the London virtual event. My interests are in aerodynamics and systems engineering, and I mostly work in MATLAB and CFD.

I'm planning to work on the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge, looking at how sunlight and Earth visibility vary between landing sites at the Moon's south pole.

 I'm always happy to chat or swap ideas, so feel free to say hello!
